questions.a: LOCATION IS LIVENESS: a file in CairnCommons/troubles/ is live; its absence means cleared. No field, no vocabulary, no guess.

GIT HISTORY IS THE PERMANENT RECORD: the move across roots (CairnCommons → ~/.cairn) means the file leaves git. But git keeps the file's last committed state in CairnCommons/troubles/ forever. The archive is operational visibility; git is the record of truth.

SAME SCHEMA, NOT NECESSARILY SAME PATH: Akien said 'same inspector, same gate, same field names' — the interface is unified. Whether the workflow PATH is shared (code-seam@v2) or trouble-specific (OPEN→CLEARED) is a design question for the chart chain.
